prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity landscape desktop website first-viewport comp, exactly 1536×1024, shown straight-on with no browser chrome, no device frame, no surrounding mockup scene.
Primary request: Design a quiet, category-standard public portfolio homepage for a developer focused on financial tools. The page should make exploring the developer’s work the clear primary action. Create a polished, realistic production-ready interface with a familiar top navigation, concise intro, featured financial app card, GitHub activity panel, compact article list, and a conventional contact/footer close all composed within the viewport while hinting at a continued second fold.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed white webpage canvas.
Subject: At the top, a restrained header with a tiny abstract blue square mark at left and the six navigation labels aligned right. Below, a two-column hero: direct introduction and primary button on the left; a substantial quiet financial dashboard project preview on the right. The preview must use abstract unlabeled charts, neutral table rows, and interface geometry only—no fake numbers or product name. The next content band shows a GitHub contribution-style activity grid in a bordered panel, plus a clean editorial article list using only the topic labels Technology, Development, and Finance rather than invented article titles. Near the bottom, include a minimal contact/footer close with simple unlabeled line icons for email and social channels, not fabricated handles or URLs.
Style/medium: High-fidelity contemporary web UI screenshot, calm editorial portfolio, crisp Swiss-influenced typography, precise spacing, clean responsive grid, quiet cards, subtle 1px borders, generous white space, mature professional visual hierarchy.
Composition/framing: 1536×1024 landscape. 12-column desktop grid with approximately 96px side margins. Slim header. Hero consumes the upper half, project preview prominent but orderly. GitHub activity and article list remain clearly visible below. A compact contact/footer close is visible near the bottom edge. Keep all text horizontal, sharp, correctly spelled, and unobstructed.
Lighting/mood: Flat digital interface, quiet, assured, useful, technically credible.
Color palette: white #FFFFFF, charcoal #111827, blue #2563EB, soft gray #E5E7EB only, with sparse blue accents and no gradients.
Materials/textures: Clean responsive grid, white and soft-gray surfaces, thin charcoal/gray rules, modest corner radii, no shadows beyond nearly imperceptible elevation.
Text (verbatim): Navigation labels “HOME”, “PROJECTS”, “ABOUT”, “RESUME”, “CONTACTS”, “BLOG”. Hero headline “Developer focused on financial tools.” Supporting line “I build and write about technology, development, and finance.” Primary action “Explore my work”. Proof labels “GitHub activity” and “Financial app project”.
Constraints: Render every required verbatim phrase exactly once and spell it exactly. Do not invent metrics, company names, clients, testimonials, app names, employers, awards, dates, financial values, follower counts, contribution totals, or performance claims. The financial preview must communicate its category only through abstract UI structure. Use category words Technology, Development, and Finance only as neutral article taxonomy. Keep the page realistic and buildable.
Avoid: gradients, glassmorphism, glossy effects, excessive pills, bento-box gimmicks, quirky metaphors, fake data, fake stock tickers, currency amounts, decorative 3D art, photos, people, giant typography, neon colors, dark mode, noisy patterns, illegible microtext, duplicated text, watermarks, browser chrome.
